data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 方法把优化知识写入可演进的行为手册，排名反馈驱动行为更新并被提交，习得行为还能迁移到未见类别，形成持久可复用的记忆改进。

scope_support.feedback_quote: an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates
scope_support.object_quote: storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors
scope_support.persistence_quote: The learned behaviors also remain effective on unseen product categories
